WITH claimed AS (
  UPDATE demo_sessions SET files_uploaded = files_uploaded + 1
  WHERE id = $1::uuid AND files_uploaded < 1
  RETURNING id
)
INSERT INTO demo_uploads (session_id, filename, status)
SELECT $1::uuid, $2::text, 'pending'
FROM claimed
RETURNING id::text AS upload_id
UPDATE demo_uploads SET status = 'extracting' WHERE id = $1::uuid

INSERT INTO demo_documents (session_id, content, metadata, embedding)
SELECT $1::uuid,
       r->>'content',
       (r->'metadata')::jsonb,
       (r->>'embedding')::vector
FROM jsonb_array_elements($2::jsonb) AS r

UPDATE demo_uploads SET status = 'ready', chunk_count = $2::int
WHERE id = $1::uuid

UPDATE demo_uploads SET status = 'failed', error = $2::text
WHERE id = $1::uuid
